text:
Maria: Heads up — during the canary for release 3.4.1 we saw a 5x error-rate spike on model-routing. Proposing we throttle the new feature flag to 0% and unpin traffic. Thoughts?
Deploy-bot: deploy log: canary rollout paused; flag `model-route-v3` set to 0 for cohort=canary by Maria :warning:
Jay: +1. What are our rollback thresholds for this rollout? We usually use 3-min sustained error > 2%.
Oliver: SRE: prefer conservative check: 3-min error > 2% OR P95 latency > 500ms triggers drain. Either condition should open an emergency hold.
Maria: OK updating plan: immediate 0% for canary, staging hold at 5% (manual), pin previous model version `rev-20231211` for all routing keys.
Sam: FYI, infra owners (cc @Paula) need to be looped. Also will update the release notes and rollback playbook.
Elaine: I'll draft a short customer-facing note and post to #customer-success once we have the temporary mitigation details.
SRE-Oncall: Also enabling verbose tracing for route-group-a shards and increasing log retention to 48h. Turning on `kv-cache:trace` now.
Jay: After the fix we should do a gradual re-introduce: 10% for 30m -> 30% for 1h -> 60% for 2h -> monitor 24h. Abort on any threshold breach.
Maria: Agreed. Add automated abort hooks on each step (error rate or latency thresholds). Manual confirmation needed for the 10% step.
Deploy-bot: scheduled holdpoint created at 6598765692 for the 10% step; resume requires explicit /deploy resume by release owner.
Oliver: I'm applying a hot patch to address KV cache eviction pattern (PR #467). ETA ~18m. Will post logs in thread.
Maria: If patch doesn't fix it, we rollback to `rev-20231209` and mark release as blocked for follow-up. Sam please prep the rollback commands and a short checklist.
Sam: Preparing: `rbctl pin model model-route rev-20231209 --global` and run smoke tests `./scripts/smoke.sh model-route`. Will attach the doc in the PR.
Maria: After stabilization we need a short postmortem + update rollout playbook with a new holdpoint for model-route canaries.
Elaine: I'll own the comms and the postmortem draft. Noting internal TL;DR for customers.
Deploy-bot: action logged: `model-route-v3` set 0 for cohort=canary by Maria at 6598765799.
Jay: Thanks. Keep updates short here — call if anything escalates. :phone:
Oliver: Patch applied, smoke tests running now. Will update in 10m.
Maria: Thanks team — appreciate quick responses.
